scenes.title: Checking in for a Flight
scenes.summary: Check your bag, choose a seat, and confirm the flight details.

expressions.text: Hi, I’d like to check in for my flight to London.
expressions.translationZh: 您好，我想办理飞往伦敦的航班值机。

expressions.noteZh: 与工作人员或陌生人交谈时礼貌得体。

expressions.text: I have one bag to check and one carry-on.
expressions.translationZh: 我有一件托运行李和一件随身行李。
expressions.note: A courteous choice when speaking with staff or strangers.
expressions.noteZh: 与工作人员或陌生人交谈时礼貌得体。

expressions.text: Is an aisle seat still available?
expressions.translationZh: 还有靠过道的座位吗？

expressions.noteZh: 与工作人员或陌生人交谈时礼貌得体。

expressions.text: Could you confirm the gate and boarding time?

expressions.noteZh: 与工作人员或陌生人交谈时礼貌得体。

expressions.text: Will my bag go straight through to my final destination?

expressions.noteZh: 与工作人员或陌生人交谈时礼貌得体。

expressions.text: What should I do next?

expressions.noteZh: 与工作人员或陌生人交谈时礼貌得体。

expressions.noteZh: 与工作人员或陌生人交谈时礼貌得体。

expressions.noteZh: 适用于职场和正式场合。
